declarations.description: Accessible text field and textarea: label, description and error wired through `for` / `aria-describedby` / `aria-invalid`, a two-way `modelValue` binding (Angular ControlValueAccessor), a character counter and opt-in autosize.
declarations.name: TextField

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The text in the field (two-way `r-model`). As the sole `model: true` prop it drives the Angular `ControlValueAccessor`, so `[(ngModel)]` and `[formControl]` bind directly. Written on every keystroke.

members.name: label
members.description: Visible label text, rendered as a `<label>` whose `for` points at the control. Leave it empty and set `ariaLabel` when the field has no visible label.

members.name: description
members.description: Help text shown under the control and linked to it through `aria-describedby`, so screen readers announce it after the label.

members.name: error
members.description: Error message. A non-empty value renders it under the control, links it through `aria-describedby`, and marks the control `aria-invalid="true"`. Clear it (empty string) once the value is valid again.

members.name: invalid
members.description: Mark the field invalid (`aria-invalid="true"` and the invalid styling) without showing a message, for example when the message is rendered elsewhere. A non-empty `error` implies this.

members.name: type
members.description: The native input `type`: `'text'`, `'email'`, `'password'`, `'search'`, `'tel'` or `'url'`. Ignored when `multiline` is set.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Placeholder text shown while the field is empty. It is not a substitute for `label`: it disappears on input and many screen readers do not announce it.

members.name: name
members.description: The native `name` attribute, used when the field sits in a plain HTML `<form>`. On Lit the control is in a shadow root, so it does not join the outer form; bind `modelValue` there.

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: The native `autocomplete` hint (e.g. `'email'`, `'current-password'`, `'off'`). Empty leaves the browser default.

members.name: required
members.description: Mark the field required: sets the native `required` attribute (announced by screen readers) and shows a `*` after the label. The marker is `aria-hidden` so it is not read twice.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disable the control. Also sets the Angular `ControlValueAccessor` disabled state.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Make the control read-only: the text is shown, focusable and selectable but cannot be edited.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: Maximum number of characters, forwarded as the native `maxlength`. `null` (the default) means no limit. With `showCount`, the counter reads `n / maxLength`.

members.name: showCount
members.description: Show a character counter under the control (`n / maxLength`, or just `n` without a limit). The counter is linked through `aria-describedby`; it is not a live region, so it does not interrupt typing.

members.name: multiline
members.description: Render a `<textarea>` instead of an `<input>`.

members.name: rows
members.description: Visible rows of a `multiline` field (the native `rows`). With `autosize` it is the minimum height.

members.name: autosize
members.description: Grow a `multiline` field to fit its content, from `rows` up to `maxRows`. It re-measures on input, on programmatic `modelValue` changes and when the field width changes.

members.name: maxRows
members.description: The tallest an `autosize` field grows, in rows; past it the textarea scrolls. `null` (the default) means no cap.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the control (`aria-label`) when there is no visible `label`.

members.name: idBase
members.description: Id base for the control and its text: the control is `idBase + '-input'`, and the description, error and counter are `-description`, `-error` and `-count`. Leave it empty (the default) and each instance generates a unique base after mount (`rozie-text-field-<n>`); set it when you need stable ids, for example to point an external element at the control. Named `idBase` (not `id`) to avoid shadowing `HTMLElement.id` on the Lit custom element.

members.name: focus
members.description: Move focus to the control (the `<input>`, or the `<textarea>` when `multiline`).

members.name: select
members.description: Focus the control and select all of its text.

members.name: clear
members.description: Empty the field: writes `modelValue = ''` (and re-measures an `autosize` field). Does not emit `change`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the user commits an edit: on blur, when the text differs from what it was when the field gained focus. Payload `{ value }`. The same on all six targets (it is not the native `change` event, which React fires on every keystroke). For every keystroke, bind `modelValue` instead.

events.name: enter
events.description: Fired when the user presses **Enter** in a single-line field, except while an IME composition is open. Payload `{ value }`. The key is not prevented, so an enclosing `<form>` still submits.

events.name: model-value-change
events.description: Fired with the updated `modelValue` (`event.detail`) when it changes.
